clues.text: This son of Beeri received the LORD's word while Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah ruled Judah.
The LORD told this prophet to take a prostitute as his wife, because the land had departed from Him.
Obeying the LORD, this prophet went and married Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim.
God told this prophet to name his first son Jezreel, because bloodshed would come upon the house of Jehu.
At God's command, this prophet named his daughter Lo-ruhamah, because God would no longer show compassion to Israel.
God said to name this prophet's second son Lo-ammi, for "you are not My people, and I am not your God."
Writing that God calls even Gentiles, an apostle quoted this prophet: God will call "My Beloved" one who was not beloved.
